// Writes Bialy's citation grammar fixture from the host parser and the host's own
// corpus. Copy to lycaon/cmd/zzexport in a scratch copy of the host and run it from
// lycaon: go run ./cmd/zzexport <commit> <out.json> <blob-dir>
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strconv"

	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"

	"github.com/lycaon/lycaon/internal/citationmd"
	"github.com/lycaon/lycaon/internal/contentblob"
	"github.com/lycaon/lycaon/internal/blobstore"
)

type citation struct {
	Handle  string `json:"handle,omitempty"`
	Path    string `json:"path,omitempty"`
	Line    int    `json:"line,omitempty"`
	EndLine int    `json:"end_line,omitempty"`
	Excerpt string `json:"excerpt,omitempty"`
}

type occurrence struct {
	Kind        string    `json:"kind"`
	Token       string    `json:"token"`
	Citation    *citation `json:"citation,omitempty"`
	Destination string    `json:"destination,omitempty"`
	Artifact    string    `json:"artifact,omitempty"`
	Method      string    `json:"method,omitempty"`
	Reason      string    `json:"reason,omitempty"`
	Target      string    `json:"target,omitempty"`
	URL         string    `json:"url,omitempty"`
}

type issue struct {
	Code  string `json:"code"`
	Kind  string `json:"kind,omitempty"`
	Token string `json:"token,omitempty"`
}

type testCase struct {
	Source      string       `json:"source"`
	Known       bool         `json:"known_paths,omitempty"`
	Occurrences []occurrence `json:"occurrences"`
	Issues      []issue      `json:"issues"`
}

func convert(c *citationmd.Citation) *citation {
	if c == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return &citation{c.Handle, c.Path, c.Line, c.EndLine, c.Excerpt}
}

func run(source string, known bool, opts citationmd.Options) (testCase, bool) {
	doc := citationmd.Parse(source, opts)
	out := testCase{Source: source, Known: known, Occurrences: []occurrence{}, Issues: []issue{}}
	for _, o := range doc.Occurrences {
		item := occurrence{Kind: string(o.Kind), Token: o.Token, Citation: convert(o.Citation), Artifact: o.Artifact}
		if o.Link != nil {
			item.Destination = o.Link.Destination
		}
		if o.Verify != nil {
			item.Method, item.Reason = o.Verify.Method, o.Verify.Reason
		}
		if o.Repair != nil {
			item.Target, item.URL, item.Citation = o.Repair.Target, o.Repair.URL, convert(o.Repair.Citation)
		}
		out.Occurrences = append(out.Occurrences, item)
	}
	for _, i := range doc.Issues {
		if i.Code == citationmd.IssueStructureBudget || i.Code == citationmd.IssueSourceBudget || i.Code == citationmd.IssueOccurrenceBudget {
			return out, false
		}
		out.Issues = append(out.Issues, issue{string(i.Code), string(i.Kind), i.Token})
	}
	return out, true
}

// literals gathers every string in the parser's test files. Names and tokens come
// along with the sources; the parser's answer on any string is a valid case.
func literals(paths []string) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, path := range paths {
		file, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), path, nil, 0)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		ast.Inspect(file, func(n ast.Node) bool {
			if lit, ok := n.(*ast.BasicLit); ok && lit.Kind == token.STRING {
				if text, err := strconv.Unquote(lit.Value); err == nil && text != "" {
					out = append(out, text)
				}
			}
			return true
		})
	}
	return out
}

func main() {
	commit, outPath, blobDir := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3]
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("config/packs/painted-wolf/platform/guidance/evidence-kinds.yaml")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var declared struct {
		Kinds map[string]any `yaml:"evidence_kinds"`
	}
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &declared); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	kinds := make([]string, 0, len(declared.Kinds))
	registered := map[string]bool{}
	for kind := range declared.Kinds {
		kinds = append(kinds, kind)
		registered[kind] = true
	}
	sort.Strings(kinds)
	knownKind := func(kind string) bool { return registered[kind] }
	knownPaths := []string{"Dockerfile", "a/b.go", "docs/x.md", "@shared/a.go", "LICENSE", "README.md"}
	knownPath := func(name string) bool {
		for _, path := range knownPaths {
			if path == name {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}

	var sources []string
	var marked []struct {
		Source string `json:"source"`
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile("internal/citationmd/testdata/marked-agreement.json")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &marked); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for _, c := range marked {
		sources = append(sources, c.Source)
	}
	var oracle struct {
		Cases []struct {
			Source string `json:"source"`
		} `json:"cases"`
	}
	data, err = os.ReadFile("internal/guidance/testdata/live-link-oracle.json")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &oracle); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for _, c := range oracle.Cases {
		sources = append(sources, c.Source)
	}
	tests, err := filepath.Glob("internal/citationmd/*_test.go")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	sources = append(sources, literals(tests)...)

	// Forms a student reply can take that the host's tables spell only inside Go helpers.
	sources = append(sources,
		"[artifact:9823b977-2c86-4057-9fcb-ef92acbbc97d]",
		"[artifact: 9823b977-2c86-4057-9fcb-ef92acbbc97d, 1823b977-2c86-4057-9fcb-ef92acbbc97d]",
		"Done [read#3:42, leg-a:grep#2:18].\n[artifact:9823b977-2c86-4057-9fcb-ef92acbbc97d]\n[verify: targeted - Ran the tests] [command#4]",
		"[read#3:42 \"if err != nil\"] and [leg-a:grep#2 internal/a.go:42]",
		"Above [scan#1].\n\n```json\n{\"headline\": \"h\"}\n```\n",
		"```markdown\nWrapped [read#1].\n```",
		"[cite: c1 => read#5:42]\n[cite: c2 => <https://example.test/a>]",
		"[auth.go](internal/auth.go#L42-L48) and [b](source://root/internal/b.go#L3) and [c](README.md#install)",
	)

	seen := map[string]bool{}
	cases := []testCase{}
	refused := 0
	for _, source := range sources {
		if seen[source] || len(source) > 4096 {
			continue
		}
		seen[source] = true
		plain, ok := run(source, false, citationmd.Options{KnownHandleKind: knownKind})
		if !ok {
			refused++
			continue
		}
		cases = append(cases, plain)
		withPaths, _ := run(source, true, citationmd.Options{KnownHandleKind: knownKind, KnownPath: knownPath})
		if encodedDiffers(plain, withPaths) {
			cases = append(cases, withPaths)
		}
	}

	envelope := []byte(`{"content":"Fixed [read#3:42].","tool_calls_json":[{"id":"c1","name":"read","args":{"path":"a.go"}}],"reasoning_json":{"text":"hidden"}}`)
	sha, _, _, err := contentblob.Write(context.Background(), blobstore.Store{Root: blobDir, Dir: contentblob.Dir}, envelope)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	body, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"host_commit": commit, "kinds": kinds, "known_paths": knownPaths, "model_output_blob": sha, "cases": cases,
	}, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(outPath, append(body, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(len(cases), "cases", refused, "refused past a budget", sha)
}

func encodedDiffers(a, b testCase) bool {
	a.Known, b.Known = false, false
	left, _ := json.Marshal(a)
	right, _ := json.Marshal(b)
	return string(left) != string(right)
}
